english.context: You can spot Madurai Meenakshi Amman temple by its gopuram from far away itself. The moment you step inside, the pillars, the lamps, the mandapam, everything looks wonderful. On the day of the Chithirai festival the crowd is more than you can bear.
english.question: What is the most coherent next sentence?
options: The crowd will go bathing at Marina Beach in Chennai.
That day the whole town will pour into the streets to watch the chariot procession.
The night shift will start at the IT company.
Snow will fall on the Himalayas.

answer.label: B
answer.text: That day the whole town will pour into the streets to watch the chariot procession.

items.explanation: The paragraph moves from the temple seen from a distance, to how beautiful it is inside, to the size of the Chithirai festival crowd, so the chariot procession on that same day carries both the place and the occasion forward. Marina Beach, an IT night shift, and Himalayan snow each drop the temple and the festival.
